title: AFOSI officer harassing a UFO whistleblower

tellings.quote: there was proof in this case of it being an AFO SI officer.

plain: Matthew Brown, introduced as a Pentagon whistleblower, spoke in 2026 on the show of a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a person who spoke out about UFOs and was then harassed. Passing on what a named person told him, Brown says there was proof in that case that the harasser was an officer of AFOSI, the US Air Force office that runs criminal and counterintelligence investigations. If true, it would mean the military itself was pressuring people who talk about UFOs.
